security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU TCG performs PMP access checks without evaluating mseccfg.MML and mseccfg.MMWP bits, or mseccfg CSR write handler accepts MML/MMWP/RLB writes without triggering PMP behavior recalculation — causing the emulated PMP to enforce pre-Smepmp semantics (M-mode always passes, L=locked) when guest software has configured Smepmp containment (M-mode restricted, L=M-mode-only)
security_spec.summary: Smepmp redefines pmpcfg.L from 'locked' to 'M-mode-only' under MML and adds MMWP default-deny for M-mode; QEMU TCG PMP handlers must consult mseccfg fields on every access check or guest TEE/secure-boot isolation is silently broken
